justification: All retained task candidates require a single agent-selected immutable artifact before trusted hidden scoring (Fable N5/N6 and MLE-bench/PaperBench source contracts). Shared byte-selection/regression fixture is independent of which public ML task is selected. Does not implement B/C/G policy or run admission.
scope: stdlib Python immutable selection-lock record and artifact-byte binding
receipt verification against actual artifact bytes and frozen protocol ID/hash
reject missing/changed artifact, malformed hashes/identity, repeated publication, and mismatched score binding
tests only use synthetic local tmpdir bytes and dummy IDs; RED failing-first then GREEN
excluded: new process or scientific run lifecycle owner
authority/scientific truth inferred from a caller-written hash
actual hidden labels/scores or protected manuscript data
tests: Run direct stdlib unittest script from this repository environment; no new dependencies. Root runs npm run check with full output after lane completion, then clean committed verification.
completion: Report actual function API, exact files/hashes, RED/GREEN commands/full outputs/test count and limitations. No commit by child.
size_guardrail: One small module + one focused regression file; no framework, CLI, background loop or generic plugin scaffold. Additional files/features need parent review.
